name: Sri Lakshmi Kirana
personality: Frequently breaks promises on initial deadlines, but clears dues when offered a 2-part split. Only answers calls after 7 PM once the evening customer rush subsides.

name: Balaji General Stores
personality: Strictly pays on the 5th of every month without fail; gets very annoyed and defensive if chased earlier. Best to send a courteous WhatsApp reminder on the 4th.

name: Venkateshwara Supermarket
personality: High-turnover store that delays payment citing slow distributor dispatch or damaged stock. Clears immediately via UPI when the sales rep visits in person during the afternoon lull (2 PM to 4 PM).

name: Sai Ram Traders
personality: Habitually requests a 7-day credit extension. Honors commitments only when firmly reminded that pending orders of high-demand staples like edible oils will be held. Prefers phone calls around 11 AM.

name: New Bharat Provision Store
personality: Good-natured shopkeeper who genuinely forgets verbal commitments amidst store bustle. Readily settles via Google Pay when an itemized statement is shared over WhatsApp before 1 PM.

name: Raghavendra Kirana & General
personality: Chronic promise breaker; frequently claims bank server issues or cheque book unavailability. Responds only to a firm 48-hour final notice or when the owner's son is contacted directly in the morning (9 AM to 10 AM).

name: Gayatri Enterprises
personality: Risk-averse with tight cash flow management. Never pays the full balance in one lump sum; pays smoothly in weekly installments of Rs 10,000 to Rs 15,000. Receptive on Tuesdays and Fridays around 5 PM.

name: Shiva Sai Departmental Store
personality: Prompt payer if provided a nominal 1.5% prompt-payment cash discount or bonus scheme. Disregards generic payment nudges without financial incentive. Best reached on weekday mornings at 10 AM.

name: Maruthi Kirana Merchant
personality: Elderly, traditional owner who refuses UPI or online bank transfers. Pays strictly in physical cash upon hand delivery of receipt by field staff on weekend mornings between 8 AM and 10 AM.

name: Sri Krishna Daily Needs
personality: Reliable and financially sound, but completely ignores phone calls while managing counter sales. Highly responsive to concise WhatsApp text messages sent between 3 PM and 5 PM, settling via NEFT within hours.

name: Durga Bhavani Super Bazaar
personality: Thorough and argumentative customer who disputes invoice calculations to stall payment. Clears payment by cheque within 24 hours once provided a signed physical delivery challan and ledger statement.

name: Annapurna Stores
personality: Small neighborhood store operating on tight margins. Very cooperative when treated with patience and empathy; clears dues in daily micro-transfers of Rs 5,000 to Rs 7,000 via UPI. Best messaged around 8 PM.
